how_to_apply: Candidates can apply online only, from 15 September 2026 to 10 October 2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
Visit the Bank's Online Application page and click "APPLY ONLINE."
Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details, and Email ID. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated and also sent via email/SMS.
Fill in the application form; use "SAVE AND NEXT" to save progress before final submission, since no changes are possible after clicking "COMPLETE REGISTRATION."
Upload your Photograph, Signature, Left Thumb Impression, and Handwritten Declaration as per the prescribed specifications.
Fill in remaining details, preview the application, and click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" only after verifying all details.
Proceed to the "Payment" tab and complete the online fee payment, then click "Submit."
Take a printout of the e-Receipt and the completed online application form for future reference.

Note: Candidates can apply for only one post. If a candidate applies for more than one post, only the latest valid (completed) application/registration will be retained, and fees paid for other registrations will stand forfeited.
important_instructions: Action against misconduct: Candidates found using unfair means, impersonation, misbehaviour in the examination/interview hall, disclosing or transmitting exam content, carrying mobile phones/electronic devices into the hall, or providing false information may be disqualified from the examination, debarred from future Bank examinations, or, if already employed, have their service terminated - in addition to being liable for criminal prosecution.

content_sections.heading: Exim Bank Deputy Manager & Manager Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 8 vacancies have been notified under this Special Recruitment Drive for backlog posts, as shown below. Reservations are applicable as per prevailing Government of India guidelines, and the reservation for PwBD candidates is on a horizontal basis for Hearing Impairment (HI) disability. Note: The reservation for PwBD candidates is on a horizontal basis for Hearing Impairment (HI) disability.

content_sections.heading: Exim Bank Deputy Manager & Manager Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility (age, educational qualification, etc.) is computed as on 31-08-2026, as detailed below for each post. Qualification: Minimum 50% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA in Graduation (minimum 3-year full-time course), AND Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade, or Chartered Accountant (CA). The Post Graduation course should be a minimum 2-year full-time duration with a specialization in Finance and minimum 50% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA. For CA, passing the professional examination is sufficient, and membership of ICAI is mandatory. Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in a scheduled commercial bank, an all-India financial institution, or another organization of repute, in internal audit / credit audit, including handling preparation and submission of reports by internal/concurrent auditors, audit compliance, analysis and timely submission of audit observations to the audit committee, review of internal/concurrent audit scope and systems/procedures/controls, and experience dealing with RBI on audit/inspection matters (in Scale I or equivalent). Qualification: Minimum 50% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA in Graduation (minimum 3-year full-time course), AND Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade, or Chartered Accountant (CA), on the same terms as above. Experience (as on 31-08-2026): Minimum 1 year of post-qualification (Post Graduation or CA) work experience in a reputed commercial bank / financial institution / state level term lending institution, with skills in project finance, credit appraisal, term lending, analysis of cross-border risks, and financing of overseas joint ventures. Candidates should possess excellent communication skills and be proficient in computers and information technology. Candidates from universities awarding CGPA/GPA instead of numerical marks must furnish a conversion letter from the head of the institute / controller of examination if the equivalent percentage is not mentioned on the marksheet. The university/institute must be recognised/approved by the Government / AICTE / UGC. Candidates who completed graduation or post-graduation through correspondence / part-time / open university / open learning / external / distance / e-learning are not eligible.

As per Government of India guidelines, the upper age limit for Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) is relaxed by an additional 10 years, and for Ex-servicemen by an additional 5 years.

content_sections.heading: Exim Bank Deputy Manager & Manager Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection comprises a Written Test followed by a Personal Interview. There is no sectional cut-off; the final list for interviews is drawn based on the candidate's overall performance in the written test. Final selection is based on combined performance in the Written Examination (out of 100, with 70% weightage) and the Interview (out of 100, with 30% weightage). A pre-recruitment training will be organised for candidates from reserved categories who opt for it through the online application form.

faq.question: Q1. What is Exim Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a Special Recruitment Drive (SRD) by the Export-Import Bank of India to fill 8 backlog vacancies for Deputy Manager (Grade JM I) and Manager (Grade MM II) posts, under Advertisement No. HRM/DM & M/SRD/2026-27/04.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Exim Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies in total - 6 for Deputy Manager (Grade/Scale JM I) and 2 for Manager (Grade/Scale MM II), against SC, ST, and OBC backlog categories.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Exim Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window is open from 15 September 2026 to 10 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Exim Bank Deputy Manager and Manager posts?
faq.answer: Both posts require a minimum 50% graduation (3-year full-time) plus a Post Graduation (MBA/PGDBA/PGDBM/MMS) with specialization in Finance/International Business/Foreign Trade, or a Chartered Accountant qualification with ICAI membership, along with relevant banking experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Exim Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As on 31-08-2026, the maximum age (including relaxation) is 33 years (SC/ST) and 31 years (OBC-NCL) for Deputy Manager, and 35 years (SC/ST) and 33 years (OBC-NCL) for Manager. PwD candidates get a further 10 years' relaxation, and Ex-servicemen get 5 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Exim Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹600/- for OBC candidates and ₹100/- (intimation charges) for SC/ST/PwBD and Female candidates, payable online and non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Exim Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a Written Test (Professional Knowledge – Subjective, 100 marks) followed by a Personal Interview, with 70% weightage to the written test and 30% to the interview in the final merit.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Exim Bank Deputy Manager and Manager posts?
faq.answer: Deputy Manager (Scale JM-I) starts on the pay band ₹48480–85920 with an approximate starting CTC of ₹18 lakh, while Manager (Scale MM-II) starts on ₹64820–93960 with an approximate starting CTC of ₹20 lakh, as per the IBA 12th Bipartite Settlement.
